title: SkillLens: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Skill Reuse for Cost-Efficient LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.08386v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Skill libraries have become a practical way for LLM agents to reuse procedural experience across tasks. However, existing systems typically treat skills as flat, single-resolution prompt blocks. This creates a tension between relevance and cost: injecting coarse skills can introduce irrelevant or misleading context, while rewriting entire skills is expensive and often unnecessary. We propose SkillLens, a hierarchical skill-evolution framework that organizes skills into a four-layer graph of policies, strategies, procedures, and primitives, and retrieves them at mixed granularity. Given a task, SkillLens first retrieves semantically relevant skill seeds, expands them through degree-corrected random walk over the skill graph, and then uses a verifier to decide whether each visited unit should be accepted, decomposed, rewritten, or skipped. translated_title: SkillLens：面向高性价比 LLM 智能体的自适应多粒度技能复用
translated_abstract: 技能库已成为 LLM 智能体跨任务复用程序化经验的一种实用方式。然而，现有系统通常将技能视为扁平的、单一分辨率的提示块，这在相关性与成本之间造成了矛盾：注入粗粒度技能可能引入无关或误导性的上下文，而重写整个技能则代价高昂且往往没有必要。我们提出 SkillLens，一个层次化的技能演化框架，它将技能组织为由策略、战略、程序和原语构成的四层图，并以混合粒度进行检索。给定一项任务，SkillLens 首先检索语义相关的技能种子，通过技能图上经度校正的随机游走对其进行扩展，然后使用验证器决定每个被访问的单元应被接受、分解、重写还是跳过。这使得智能体能够直接复用兼容的子技能，同时仅对局部不匹配的部分进行适配，从而兼顾了复用的相关性与成本效率。
tldr: SkillLens 提出由策略、战略、程序和原语构成的四层技能图，结合混合粒度检索与验证器驱动的接受、分解、重写、跳过决策机制，使 LLM 智能体能够低成本、自适应地复用技能。
en_tdlr: SkillLens organizes skills into a four-layer graph of policies, strategies, procedures, and primitives, and combines mixed-granularity retrieval with verifier-guided accept, decompose, rewrite, or skip decisions, enabling LLM agents to reuse skills adaptively at low cost.
